text: The future of artificial intelligence is a topic that attracts a lot of attention. Today we have "general AI" – systems that are good at specific tasks, like translating languages or recommending films. However, many researchers are working on AGI, or artificial general intelligence: machines that can understand and learn any task a human can do. The potential benefits are enormous, from solving medical problems to making education cheaper. But there are also serious risks, such as job losses or systems we cannot control. Experts disagree about the timeline. Some predict AGI within ten years, while others believe it is still many decades away.
